items.raw_excerpt: The English term "plusbus" won a public competition, but Tampere's transport operator quietly changed the name to the more Finnish-sounding "plusbussi".
items.summary_en: The English term "plusbus" won a public competition for a new Tampere bus name. But the transport operator quietly changed it to the more Finnish-sounding "plusbussi". The change started a small debate about language.
items.summary_ko: 새 탬페레 버스 이름을 정하는 공개 공모에서 영어 단어 플러스버스가 뽑혔습니다. 그런데 교통 운영사가 이를 더 핀란드어스러운 플러스부시로 조용히 바꿨습니다. 이 변경으로 언어에 대한 작은 논쟁이 벌어졌습니다.
items.title_en: Tampere bus name sparks language debate
items.title_ko: 탬페레 버스 이름 두고 언어 논쟁
items.title_original: What's in a name? Tampere bus sparks language row

items.raw_excerpt: Tamil Nadu announces a new women’s college in Chennai, enhancing education for Muslim girls and supporting minority communities.
items.summary_en: Tamil Nadu announces a new women's college in Chennai. The college aims to enhance education for Muslim girls and support minority communities.

items.raw_excerpt: The Portuguese women's volleyball team achieved its first-ever victory in the European Championships on 26 August, beating Spain 3-1 in a Group C match held in Baku.
items.summary_en: Portugal's women's volleyball team won its first European Championship match on August 26. The team beat Spain 3-1 in a Group C game held in Baku.

items.raw_excerpt: As part of the celebrations marking the 136th anniversary of São Sebastião, one of the two civil parishes in Loulé, a sculptural landmark was unveiled on Thursday, August 13, along the path beside Loulé/Praia de Quarteira railway station.
items.summary_en: Loulé marked the 136th birthday of the São Sebastião parish with a new sculpture. The statue was placed along the path beside the railway station between Loulé and Praia de Quarteira.
items.summary_ko: 룰레의 산 세바스티앙 구역은 설립 136주년을 기념해 철도 유산을 담은 조형물을 공개했다. 조형물은 룰레와 프라이아 드 콰르테이라를 잇는 철도역 옆 길에 세워졌다.
items.title_en: Sculpture in Loulé honors railway history
items.title_ko: 룰레에 철도 역사 기념 조형물 공개
items.title_original: Sculpture celebrates Railway Heritage in Loulé

items.raw_excerpt: Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) hosted a traditional Ghost Festival prayer ceremony in Taipei on Wednesday, with representatives from Taiwan's diplomatic allies and other friendly countries taking part for the first time.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's foreign minister hosted a traditional Ghost Festival prayer ceremony in Taipei. Representatives from diplomatic allies and friendly countries joined the ceremony for the first time.

items.title_original: Foreign envoys attend Taiwan Ghost Festival ceremony at MOFA

items.raw_excerpt: The new restrictions were introduced in May to tackle "inconsiderate" parking.
items.summary_en: A national park introduced new parking rules in May to stop inconsiderate parking. The rules brought in 4,600 pounds in parking fines.

items.raw_excerpt: Our Swedish word of the day is the kind of insult you really only get here in Scandinavia.
items.summary_en: Today's Swedish word is badkruka. It means someone who is too afraid of cold water to go for a swim. It is the kind of teasing word you only hear in Scandinavia.
items.summary_ko: 오늘의 스웨덴어는 바드크루카입니다. 차가운 물이 무서워 수영을 못 하는 사람을 일컫는 말입니다. 스칸디나비아에서나 통하는 그런 놀림 말입니다.
items.title_en: Swedish word of the day: badkruka
items.title_ko: 오늘의 스웨덴어: 바드크루카
items.title_original: Swedish word of the day: badkruka

items.raw_excerpt: If you're shopping in France it's highly likely that you will see food and drinks that proudly declare their AOP or AOC status - but are these products actually better than the rest?
items.summary_en: Many foods and drinks in France carry the AOP or AOC label. These labels mean the product is made in a specific place using traditional methods. People often wonder if labeled products are actually better than others.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스에서 장을 보다 보면 AOP나 AOC 표시가 있는 음식과 음료를 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 이 표시는 특정 지역에서 전통적인 방법으로 만들어진 제품이라는 뜻입니다. 많은 사람들이 이런 표시가 있는 제품이 정말 더 나은지 궁금해합니다.
items.title_en: AOP/AOC: France's special food labels explained
items.title_ko: AOP/AOC란 무엇일까요, 프랑스 음식과 와인 표시
items.title_original: What does the AOP/AOC label on French food and wine mean - and are these products better?

items.raw_excerpt: Amsterdam mayor Femke Halsema wants to decriminalise sleeping outdoors, despite objections from residents of the Plantage neighbourhood in the east of the city. Residents have launched a petition to prevent that from happening, according to AT5. Sleeping on the street or in parks is technically a fineable offence, although in practice no one has been fined over the past year. The mayor now wants it to become official policy. Plantage resident Dennis de Vreede, who supports the petition, said he
items.summary_en: The Amsterdam mayor wants to make sleeping outside legal instead of a fineable offence. Neighbours in the Plantage neighbourhood started a petition against this plan. No one has been fined for sleeping outside in the past year.
items.summary_ko: 암스테르담 시장이 길거리나 공원에서 잠을 자는 것을 처벌 대상이 아니라 합법으로 인정하려고 합니다. 이 계획에 반대하는 플란타허 지역 주민들은 청원을 시작했습니다. 지난 1년간 야외 취침으로 벌금을 받은 사람은 없었습니다.
items.title_en: Amsterdam mayor wants to scrap fines for sleeping outdoors

items.title_original: Amsterdam mayor wants to scrap fines for sleeping outdoors

items.raw_excerpt: Vegetable prices in Yadgir remain stable, except for drumsticks and beans, which surged to ₹100 per kg.
items.summary_en: Vegetable prices in Yadgir, Karnataka remain mostly stable. Only drumsticks and beans have become dearer, now selling at ₹100 per kilogram.

items.raw_excerpt: The Bolt electric scooter and bicycle service will end in September in Vila Real, by decision of the company, which no longer has an operator to maintain and relocate the equipment, the city hall said.
items.summary_en: The Bolt electric scooter and bicycle service will end in Vila Real in September. The company no longer has someone to maintain and move the equipment. The city hall said this is the company's decision.

items.title_ko: 볼트 전동 킥보드와 전기 자전거, 9월에 빌라헤알에서 종료

items.raw_excerpt: Luego de la victoria de Universidad Católica ante Coquimbo Unido, el defensor Agustín García Basso manifestó su felicidad por sumar de a tres y reencontrarse con la actividad tras meses sin jugar. El flamante zaguero cruzado destacó la tranquilidad del equipo para revertir el trámite en el segundo tiempo bajo las instrucciones de Daniel Garnero, resaltó su rápida adaptación al plantel y aprovechó la instancia para dedicarle el triunfo a José María Buljubasich por haber confiado en él y gestionar
items.summary_en: After Universidad Católica beat Coquimbo Unido, defender Agustín García Basso said he was happy to get three points and return to play after months without games. He thanked coach José María Buljubasich for trusting him and helping him join the team.
items.summary_ko: 유니베르시다드 카톨리카가 코킴보 우니도에 이긴 뒤, 수비수 아구스틴 가르시아 바소는 3점을 얻고 몇 달 만에 경기에 복귀해 기쁘다고 말했습니다. 그는 팀에 합류하도록 도와주고 믿어준 감독 호세 마리아 불주바시치에게 승리를 바쳤습니다.
items.title_en: Soccer defender dedicates win to coach who trusted him
items.title_ko: 수비수, 자신을 믿어준 감독에게 승리를 바쳐
items.title_original: García Basso le dedicó la victoria a Buljubasich: Es para él, porque me dio la confianza

items.raw_excerpt: The Rotary Club Estoi Palace International is proud to announce the return of acclaimed Swiss baritone Äneas Humm, who will perform at the historic Teatro Lethes in Faro, Portugal’s second-oldest theatre.
items.summary_en: A Swiss baritone named Äneas Humm will give a concert at Teatro Lethes in Faro. The theatre is Portugal's second-oldest theatre. It is a special event organized by the local Rotary Club.

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan's Civil Aviation Administration (CAA) has allowed Mandarin Airlines to reduce flights on two Hualien routes when passenger demand is weak, but has not approved the carrier's request to suspend the services altogether.
items.summary_en: An airline is allowed to reduce flights to Hualien, a city in Taiwan. The regulator said the airline can cut flights when few people travel. But it did not approve stopping the flights completely.

items.summary_en: South Africa's Reserve Bank released a new R2 coin. It honors Charlotte Maxeke and the women of 1956. One side of the coin shows those women gathered in front of the Union Buildings.

items.raw_excerpt: A 91-year-old woman served with an eviction notice at a seniors’ apartment building in Windsor is celebrating after a tribunal ruled that the notice is “defective.”
items.summary_en: A 91-year-old woman in Windsor, Ontario was served with an eviction notice at her seniors' apartment building. The tribunal ruled that the notice was defective. She is celebrating the decision.

items.title_original: A 91-year-old woman was handed an eviction order. Why the Ontario tribunal ruled it 'defective'

items.raw_excerpt: Espécie, apresentada em estudo científico da Uerj, oferece a oportunidade de conhecer a vida no continente sul-americano há cerca de 254 milhões de anos.
items.summary_en: Scientists at a university found a fossil of a prehistoric fish in Mato Grosso. The discovery helps us learn about life in South America about 254 million years ago. It was presented in a scientific study.

items.raw_excerpt: El potente dardo que lanzó Universidad de Concepción tras reunirse con Comisión de Arbitros por polémicos cobros
items.summary_en: Universidad de Concepcion met with the referees' commission after controversial calls in recent matches. The club complained about the penalty decisions. Their message to the referees was: 'We don't expect to have 12 penalties called on us.'
items.summary_ko: 콘셉시온의 축구팀 U. 데 콘셉시온이 최근 경기의 논란 많은 심판 판정 문제로 심판위원회와 만났습니다. 구단은 페널티 판정에 불만을 드러냈습니다. "우리는 페널티 12개를 받을 생각이 없다"는 뜻을 전했습니다.

items.title_original: U. de Concepción se reunió con Comisión de Árbitros y lanzó dardo: "No aspiramos a que nos cobren 12 penales"

items.raw_excerpt: Pista no sentido Recife foi interditada com pneus incendiados em Jaboatão dos Guararapes. Manifestação foi encerrada por volta das 8h20 desta quinta-feira (27).
items.summary_en: People blocked a highway with burning tires to protest a lack of water in Jaboatão dos Guararapes, Brazil. The road toward Recife was closed and caused heavy traffic. The protest ended around 8:20 am on Thursday.

items.title_en: Water shortage protest blocks highway in Brazil
items.title_ko: 브라질 물 부족 항의로 고속도로 봉쇄
items.title_original: Protesto motivado por falta de água causa engarrafamento na BR-101, em Jaboatão dos Guararapes; VÍDEO - G1

items.raw_excerpt: A number of historical finds were uncovered at the site.
items.summary_en: People at a community dig in south east Cornwall found medieval village walls. They also uncovered a number of historical finds at the site. The discovery came from a local volunteering event.
items.summary_ko: 영국 콘월 남동부에서 열린 공동 발굴에서 중세 마을의 담벼락이 드러났다. 발굴에 참여한 지역 주민들은 현장에서 역사적 유물도 여럿 발견했다. 이번 발견은 지역 주민들이 함께한 발굴 활동 덕분에 나온 결과다.
